sections.title: Transactions - All Your Spending, One Dashboard
sections.description:
Ever felt like your money just disappears? Akkountant makes sure you know exactly where it's going. 🕵️

Users can link their Gmail accounts, and Akkountant will automatically scan for transaction emails from six supported bank accounts:

  • HDFC Debit
  • HDFC Credit (Millennia)
  • BOI Debit
  • ICICI Amazon Pay
  • YES Bank Credit (ACE)
  • YES Bank Debit

If auto-fetching isn't your thing, you can upload your bank statements manually, and Akkountant will take care of the rest.

  • Transactions are parsed, categorized, and stored securely.
  • Statements are also uploaded to your Google Drive, keeping everything organized in one place.
  • Your Gmail is also monitored for monthly statements, ensuring no transaction is ever lost.

The result? A single dashboard where you can analyze your spending patterns, track expenses across banks, and take control of your finances.

sections.title: Technical Details - Making Magic Happen
sections.description:
Under the hood, Akkountant uses a modular architecture to keep things clean, scalable, and efficient. 🏗️

  • Google API Integration: A parent GoogleService class handles token generation and service instantiation, with child classes dedicated to Gmail and Google Drive operations.
  • Statement Processing: Parsing bank statements isn’t one-size-fits-all, so a Parser parent class standardizes parsing logic while child classes handle the quirks of each bank's statement format.
  • Automated Fetching: A StatementDownloadService runs periodically to scan Gmail and download statements, handling different bank formats seamlessly.
  • Data Integrity & Security: Custom ID generation, token renewal, cron jobs for periodic scans, and multiple integrity checks ensure smooth operation.

With this robust backend, transactions flow seamlessly from your emails to your database—like magic, but with Python. 🐍✨

sections.title: Investments - Because Your Money Should Work for You
sections.description:
Keeping track of investments can be a nightmare—Akkountant makes it a dream. 🌟

We support six different types of investments:

  • 1️⃣    PPF (Public Provident Fund):

    Upload deposit records, and Akkountant calculates interest based on the latest rates fetched via web scraping.

  • 2️⃣   EPF (Employee Provident Fund):

    Upload your EPF statement PDFs, and deposits are automatically tracked and updated using parsed data.

  • 3️⃣    Mutual Funds:

    Pick from a vast list of mutual funds (fetched via an open-source API), and get real-time profit/loss calculations.

  • 4️⃣   NPS (National Pension Scheme):

    Upload your NPS PDF statements, and Akkountant will parse transactions while fetching real-time NAV rates.

  • 5️⃣   Stocks:

    Upload Zerodha statements to track stock holdings. The latest prices are fetched via the NSE API.

  • 6️⃣   Gold:

    Manually enter purchases, and Akkountant will fetch real-time rates for 18K, 22K, and 24K gold using web scraping.

With these tools, you’re not just tracking investments—you’re mastering them. 📈🔥

sections.title: Technical Details - Keeping Data Fresh & Accurate
sections.description:
Akkountant doesn’t just show you old, stale numbers—it keeps investment data fresh with automated updates. 🔄

  • Cron Jobs for Data Updates: Rates for stocks, mutual funds, and gold are fetched automatically at scheduled intervals.
  • Efficient Processing: Some jobs make 45,000+ HTTP requests per update cycle—multiprocessing ensures these updates take just 5 minutes.
  • Storage Optimization: Rates are stored in dynamically generated JSON files, reducing load times and ensuring fast retrieval.

This means you always have the latest financial data at your fingertips—no manual refresh needed. ⏳✨

sections.title: Project Overview - Tech Stack & Deployment
sections.description:
Akkountant is built with performance, security, and scalability in mind. 🚀

  • Backend: Flask (Python) with SQLAlchemy ORM.
  • Frontend: React (designed by yours truly 😎), fully responsive.
  • Authentication: Firebase for seamless user authentication.
  • Deployment: Hosted on a Linux server with Nginx, running on a custom domain.
  • Architecture: Follows MVC (Model-View-Controller) for clean code separation.
  • Endpoints: 23 APIs power all transactions, investments, and automation features.

Akkountant isn’t just another finance tracker—it’s your personal finance powerhouse. 🏆💰
